title: Rail Weapon VFX
description: Rail Weapon VFX. Milestone 2 credit burn, v1.0. Projectile is an 8×64 strip. Charge, static AOE, and hit are 1-frame images (AOE pose 96×96). `vfx-rail-aoe-explode` is the 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Does not replace live hero weapon sheets (fx-sling-pellet, frost, flame, bubble, lightning). Water was not part of this export. SFX keys are notes only; no audio files.

assets.note: v1.0. 8-frame fly strip. Does not replace live lightning sheets. PixelLab object c84f6bc4-8815-4ac4-aeef-ef09ffec570c. SFX `sfx-weapon-rail-shot` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame charge. Static 1-frame. Stage can tween or scale. PixelLab object 348bd457-3077-4ba8-8ba0-71e416a83497. SFX `sfx-weapon-rail-charge` (index note only; no audio file).

v1.0. Static 1-frame AOE impact pose, kept as the fallback. Animated ground burst is `vfx-rail-aoe-explode` (8×96, origin (0.5, 0.75)). PixelLab object 5673e5af-4414-4abb-8125-f2c1e2b18618. SFX `sfx-weapon-rail-aoe` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame hit. PixelLab object 511d1515-62ed-4a77-8c9c-f1af20b72407. SFX `sfx-weapon-rail-hit` (index note only; no audio file).
